review_candidates.title: Member of Technical Staff
review_candidates.description: About Perimeter The limit on superintelligence (SI) is no longer chips. It's power. New data centers wait years for a grid connection, while the office towers, hotels and hospitals of every major city sit on power they were built for and no longer use. Perimeter Compute is on a mission to put that power to work. We turn basements and mechanical rooms into GPU clusters, and our software links them into one inference network running inside the cities where SI will be used. Building owners earn from space that would otherwise sit idle. Frontier labs and inference providers get capacity without the years-long wait, a few miles from their users instead of a few states away. Perimeter is a small, highly leveraged team that has worked every layer of this problem: building GPU infrastructure at Lambda and HPE, engineering commercial buildings at Tishman Speyer and Trane, and routing inference at Subquadratic. The power is already there. Come build what runs on it. How We Work People make the decisions that matter. Agents do everything else. Agents write and review all of our code. People own the calls that are hard to undo: architecture, product direction, taste, and the frameworks we use to make those calls. Most decisions are two-way doors, so you make the call instead of waiting for one. If you like writing code yourself, you'll hate it here. One owner per outcome. You build it, you run it, you grow it. Roles here are bigger than usual. You'll do work that's normally split across engineering, product, sales and design. You'll work directly with customers to figure out what to build. You own the outcome, so you decide how to get there. If you want a clear ticket and someone else owning the result, this isn't the job. We Keep Reinventing How Software Gets Built. Code is a means to an end, not the end. We question every assumption. "Why?" is the most important question you can ask, and a rule nobody can answer it for gets deleted. How we build is code too. Every week, agents find what slowed us down and ship the fix. If you want a process that stays the same, look elsewhere. We build for agents as much as for people. Agents use our tools, APIs, docs and interfaces too. It isn't done until an agent can use it and recover from its errors without help. Every public API is defined once in code, and everything people and agents read about it is generated from that, so nothing drifts. Agents don't remember rules, so anything that matters is a check that fails, not a line in a doc. Because agents do the work, we can be prescriptive: one way to build things, and every agent follows it. If docs and error messages feel like someone else's job, we're not a fit. About The Role Our GPUs live in the basements and mechanical rooms of buildings we don't own, with no one from our team on site day to day. No two buildings are the same. Each one has to be found and vetted, and every GPU in it set up, watched, repaired and billed from somewhere else, without customers ever having to think about any of it. Most of the systems that make that work don't exist yet. You'll build them: pick up whichever one matters most, work out what it needs to do with the people who'll use it, and take it to production, usually alongside the person who will own it. Once it's running and healthy, you either own it or hand it off and start the next one. You're measured on whether what you launch is still running well 90 days later. What You'll Do Pick up whichever launch matters most. As of November 2026, the list includes: Getting managed Kubernetes from its first cluster to its first paying customer Networking that ties every site together, from the fabric inside a building to the links between them Taking provisioning from our digital twin (a software replica of a whole site) to real hardware, so bringing up a new site is a run of software, not a project The loop that catches a failing GPU, pulls the node, gets the part replaced and retests it, without a person driving each step The software that finds buildings with spare power and works out what each one can support The company's memory: a permanent record of our decisions and conversations, and the knowledge graph our agents will build from it Usage metering, billing and the internal tools the company runs on Work out what to build by talking to the people who'll use it, customers and teammates alike Take each system from a rough idea to production, and carry the pager for it Write down what you decided and why, so whoever runs it next, person or agent, can do it without you Good fit if you Have built and run production software that people depend on, and owned it when it broke, whether that took you two years or ten Have figured out what to build without a spec, shipped it and carried the pager for it Have worked below the app layer: Linux, networking, hardware or distributed systems Have built something where real money or hardware was on the line, like billing, provisioning or fleet operations Get real results from coding agents and know where to check their work Have handed off a system you built, and it kept running well without you Nice to have Bare metal, networking or GPU infrastructure Long-running workflows with Temporal or similar Power, cooling or building management systems Billing, metering or usage-based pricing Forward-deployed or solutions engineering work with customers Early-stage startup experience Location Fully remote in the US. We aren't able to sponsor visas at this time. Benefits Health, dental and vision insurance Unlimited PTO A $500 home office stipend A top-spec MacBook Unlimited tokens Don't meet every bullet? Apply anyway. We care more about what you've built and how you think than about checking every box. Please write your answers to the application questions yourself, without AI. After you apply, we'll tell you how to use AI in each interview round. We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. Perimeter Compute is an equal opportunity employer. We don't discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status or any other legally protected status. If you need an accommodation at any point in our hiring process, email careers@perimetercompute.com. Compensation Range: $150K - $250K

Working knowledge of Power Automate, including maintaining and troubleshooting flows. Familiarity with SharePoint usage analytics and reporting. Understanding of web accessibility standards and how to apply them to site content. Ability to learn new tools and processes quickly and apply them effectively. Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills. Able to work independently, manage your own task list, and handle time-sensitive requests calmly. Excellent communication skills, including the ability to clearly and concisely communicate with clients via email, Teams chat, and video calls. NICE TO HAVE AI experience, such as writing and refining reusable prompts, building Copilot or SharePoint agents, and automating manual, prompt-based processes. Experience managing identity and access groups in Entra ID or similar tools. Experience supporting internal communications or marketing teams in a large enterprise. Microsoft certifications (for example, MS-900 or PL-900). Experience at a consulting or professional services firm. review_candidates.description: We are looking for a Sales Executive - Oyarifa territory in Greater Accra Region, to join our Sales Team, as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets. The customers your team reaches aren't switching providers for a better deal. For many of them, this is the first time anyone has offered them credit at all. We're in active expansion mode, moving from 7 million toward 10 million customers. The infrastructure being built right now, the teams, the networks, the local market strategies will define how fast we get there. You'd be joining at exactly the moment when what you build has the most to shape. About Us M-KOPA has grown to 10 million customers across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, and South Africa, extending over $2 billion in credit to people building better lives one asset at a time. 86% of our customers report improved satisfaction, and 55% are accessing formal financial services for the first time through us. Behind that scale sits a network of over 35,000 field agents and 2,300+ employees, all working toward one goal: helping Every Day Earners own more, faster. This is an on-site role , you would be working from our offices in Ghana, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Regional Manager. What You'll Do Recruit, train, coach and supervise a field-based team of Direct Sales Representatives, monitoring their performance consistently against M-KOPA's standards while managing DSR inventory and resolving audit recommendations in line with company guidelines. Design and execute the sales and marketing strategy for your territory, setting the direction for weekly, monthly, and quarterly target achievement while monitoring and analyzing the performance of marketing campaigns. Deliver and exceed sales targets across your designated territory by developing strong local networks that uphold M-KOPA's brand values and retail point standards. What You'll Bring Demonstrable experience in sales within microfinance, insurance, telecommunications, mobile money, FMCG, or related sectors in Ghana, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets. Established expertise in recruiting, coaching, and leading field-based sales teams; you know how to get performance from people, not just compliance. Proven ability to design and execute territory-level sales and marketing strategies that translate into consistent weekly, monthly, and quarterly results. The honest part This role operates in the field, across communities that aren't always easy to reach. The targets are real, the accountability is direct, and the pace reflects a business that's scaling fast. If you're energized by that rather than exhausted by reading it, that's probably worth paying attention to. Why M-KOPA? At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility. Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com . Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.
